mapper.select: SELECT ac.seq, ac.login_id AS loginId, ac.name, ac.birth, ac.gender::text AS gender, (SELECT val FROM sys_code_det WHERE code = 'USER_TYPE_CD' AND cd = ac.user_type_cd) AS userTypeNm, ts.disease::json->>'name' AS diseaseName FROM account ac LEFT JOIN track_service ts ON ts.account_seq = ac.seq AND ts.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ts.is_enabled WHERE ac.seq = #{accountSeq} AND ac.is_enabled = true AND ac.is_dropped = false LIMIT 1

SELECT ac.seq, ac.login_id AS loginId, ac.name, ac.birth, ac.gender::text AS gender, (SELECT val FROM sys_code_det WHERE code = 'USER_TYPE_CD' AND cd = ac.user_type_cd) AS userTypeNm, ts.disease::json->>'name' AS diseaseName FROM account ac LEFT JOIN track_service ts ON ts.account_seq = ac.seq AND ts.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ts.is_enabled WHERE ac.login_id = #{loginId} AND ac.is_enabled = true AND ac.is_dropped = false LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(step_num, 0) FROM account_step_history WHERE account_seq = #{accountSeq} AND execution_date = to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(step_num)), 0)::bigint FROM account_step_history WHERE account_seq = #{accountSeq} AND execution_date::date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days'

SELECT scd.cd AS categoryCd, scd.val AS categoryNm, CASE WHEN tot_q = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tot_a::decimal / tot_q * 100, 1) END AS progress FROM sys_code_det scd CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM coaching_question_info cqi WHERE cqi.progress_type_cd IN ('A1','E01','K01') AND cqi.category_cd = scd.cd) AS tot_q, (SELECT count(DISTINCT step_day_cd) FROM coaching_user_answer_info cuai WHERE cuai.account_seq = #{accountSeq} AND cuai.category_cd = scd.cd) AS tot_a ) x WHERE scd.code = 'CATEGORY_CD' AND scd.use_yn = 'Y' AND scd.cd IN ('A','B','C','D','E') ORDER BY scd.cd

SELECT cc.seq AS contentsSeq, cc.title, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(cc.contents, '<[^>]+>', '', 'g'), 120) AS preview, to_char(cc.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM cm_contents cc INNER JOIN hospital_service hs ON hs.account_seq = #{accountSeq} WHERE cc.is_enabled = true ORDER BY cc.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
